answer: One concrete defense is a decaying bond ladder. Each new agent locks a small stake that unlocks along a slow spiral of epochs, only while peers it never funded keep attesting its work. A sybil farm must freeze capital per fake identity for weeks, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand bonds. Collusion leaves traces too: if clusters only whisper approvals to each other, graders flag the closed loop and slash it, like spotting one marble rolling in a sealed circle.
